proofs.text: Run the auto-approval over the same project; verify no path written names `RULE-2`, the high-risk rule

reasons: PROOF-16 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: CI never auto-approves a rule tagged `[risk: high]` or `[risk: medium]`

tests.body:
def test_high_risk_is_never_auto_approved(self, proved):
        written = approve_module.auto_approve(proved.root)
        assert [path for path in written if 'RULE-2' in path] == [], (
            'RULE-2 is high risk and needs a person')
tests.name: test_high_risk_is_never_auto_approved
